bearerAuth.description: A personal access token from Settings → API tokens.

users_count.description: Only on the listing, which counts them.

id.description: The user's id, which is what the member routes address them by.

limit.description: Null means no limit, which is not the same as a limit of zero.

key.description: What the organization rules match on.

deleted_at.description: Only present on something in the trash.

current_location.description: Where the physical document is now, not where it has been.

is_previewable.description: Whether this application will serve the file inline. An SVG is image/* and is still served as an opaque download, so this cannot be worked out from the mime type.

ocr_text.description: Only on a single attachment, never on a listing.

file_uploaded_at.description: When the file sitting here now arrived, which stops agreeing with created_at the first time something replaces it.

superseded_at.description: When this file stopped being the current one. The chain is not numbered; these two dates are what identify a version.

value_strategy.description: Whether a node here is allocated a value or has to be given one.

is_leaf.description: The bottom tier: where documents come to rest.

path.description: Assembled by walking the node's ancestors, so no column holds it and nothing can be sorted by it.

url.description: What the printed code points at. The URL rather than a rendered image, so a client can choose its own size, margins and error correction.

support.description: How many times the archive saw it before proposing it.

progress.description: Counted in attachments rather than in queued jobs, and only while a sweep is running.

result_available.description: Whether there is a file to download. Where it sits on disk is not reported.

label.description: What the entry is about, recorded when it happened so it survives the thing it names being deleted.

replaces_attachment_id.description: Set when the session is aimed at replacing one file rather than adding a page. Such a session takes one photo and ends.

pairing_url.description: The signed link the phone loads and uploads through. The interface renders it as a QR code; this is the URL that code carries.

MetadataSuggestions.description: Suggested values keyed by kind. Nothing is applied until it is accepted by kind.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or an expired one.

Forbidden.description: The token is valid; its user may not do this.

NotFound.description: Not there, or not this user's to see. An id belonging to another workspace is reported as missing rather than as forbidden.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100. Values outside that are clamped, not rejected, and meta.per_page reports what was used.
